author: Antigravity Research Team
objective: Investigate normalization stability and evaluate controlled variance-floored and robust scaling ablations to resolve extreme feature blow-ups and false-alarm amplification.

safeguards.global_parameter_fitting: Strictly Candidate A Training data only

audit_findings_summary.root_cause: Historical standard deviations for stationary tasks and jobs drop below 1e-4, while epsilon was hardcoded at 1e-5. This causes minor telemetry fluctuations to scale up to >12,000 standard deviations, blowing up linear activations in neural models.

ablation_a.name: Ablation A: Existing Hierarchical Baseline (eps=1e-5, unfloored)
ablation_a.description: Standard hierarchical causal baseline from Phase 7G with no variance floor (eps=1e-5).
ablation_a.loss: CrossEntropyLoss with Condition C training-only inverse-frequency weights w = [1.0, 11.463, 11.802]

ablation_b.name: Ablation B: Hierarchical Causal Baseline with Variance Floor (sigma_floor=0.05)
ablation_b.description: Hierarchical causal baseline where historical denominator is floored at max(sigma_hist, 0.05). Floor derived as 5% of cluster population scale from training data.
ablation_b.loss: CrossEntropyLoss with Condition C training-only inverse-frequency weights w = [1.0, 11.463, 11.802]

ablation_c.name: Ablation C: Robust Causal Scaling with Median, MAD, and Soft Tanh Bounding
ablation_c.description: Hierarchical causal baseline using historical Median for centering, MAD*1.4826 (floored at 0.05) for scale, and soft hyperbolic tangent clipping to [-5.0, 5.0].
ablation_c.loss: CrossEntropyLoss with Condition C training-only inverse-frequency weights w = [1.0, 11.463, 11.802]

operational_acceptance_gates.gate_2: Pure-normal Entity FAR <= 10.0% AND Normal-window FPR <= 5.0%
operational_acceptance_gates.eligibility_rule: A model is operationally eligible ONLY if it satisfies BOTH Gate 1 and Gate 2 simultaneously.
